subject: coordinate quantization only

sourceEvidence.facts: 512 scale; rounded float-to-uint16; inverse scale; direction low nibble, state high nibble; packed 9B SectorUpdateEntry; max 100 entries
MakeSectorUpdates writes ID, QuantizePos(x), QuantizePos(y), PackDirState

beforeHistoricalSource: Supplied Notion page: ID 4 + direction 1 + state 1 + x 4 + y 4 = 14B. Current checkout has the accepted 9B wire format.
invariants: Server float coordinates and actor movement are identical before and after.
Two 4B float fields become two 2B uint16 fields.
Multiply by 512 and round before serialization.
qx and qy are tick indices in 1/512-tile units.
Only converted uint16 values are written into after Msg.
No wiring, contact pads or signal effects between components.
There is exactly one block transfer per comparison row.
Moving blocks become stored Msg blocks without a fade, gap, second fill or change in position, size or values.
Other protocol fields and physical send are omitted from the diagram.
diagramAbstractions: The conversion component is a software stage, not hardware or an allocated buffer.
The transfer illustrates writing coordinate values to Msg.
Byte-block shrink compares wire representations, not in-place memory compression.
Two coordinates move together in the diagram, not actual individual field write timings.
Only coordinate bytes are counted, not the entire packet.
Actor movement and timings are schematic.
styleReference: serial-sector-bank-v1/figure-3.html palette, embedded fonts, mage, structural strokes and before-after treatment
arrivalBehavior: One coordinate-block transfer from conversion to Msg. The block remains fully visible during transfer and becomes identical stored data at arrival. No wiring or second fill animation.
